What's new in 1.1.0

- Work on another Git branch in its own project folder with worktrees.
- Format notes with headings, bold, lists, checklists, quotes and code, with undo and preview.
- Send a short note to guide the next step of a running chat. Edit or cancel it before delivery.
- Manage work in a To Do, In progress and Done task board.
- Find devices with search and reach their connection and access controls more easily.
- Use richer chat and project menus, Home pins, terminal rename and duplication, and automation templates and sorting.
- Project browsers remember their last page and recent ports.
- See clearer usage charts and new plush characters that keep their shape as they move.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements for chat, project navigation and reviewing file changes.
